title: NRF. Failed in heartbeat processing msg

labels.name: Help Wanted
labels.description: Maintainers are not working on this issue so community help is wanted.

body:
Hello @acetcom!

I am trying to implement my own library to connect with NRF. In current provided test, I've mocked SCP ("nfInstanceId":	"bbbba398-236c-41ed-97a8-63da716897b4") NF with my library and processed registration and heartbeat message. Also in current shecme of 5G NFs connection I use several componnets from open5gs implementation. Current Open5GS version is v2.4.9-25-g444e182

In attached log file you could see that my library successfully made registration. After that, I send the heatbeat message, which processed with error.
```
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] DEBUG: [PATCH] /nnrf-nfm/v1/nf-instances/bbbba398-236c-41ed-97a8-63da716897b4 (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:796)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] DEBUG: RECEIVED: 58 (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:799)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] DEBUG: [{"op":"replace","path":"/nfStatus","value":"REGISTERED"}] (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:800)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [nrf] DEBUG: nrf_state_operational(): NRF_EVT_SBI_SERVER (../src/nrf/nrf-sm.c:50)
[{"op":"replace","path":"/nfStatus","value":"REGISTERED"}]08/26 14:34:57.178: [core] ERROR: OpenAPI_nf_profile_parseFromJSON() failed [nf_instance_id] (../lib/sbi/openapi/model/nf_profile.c:1368)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] ERROR: JSON parse error (../lib/sbi/message.c:1073)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] ERROR: parse_content() failed (../lib/sbi/message.c:655)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [nrf] ERROR: cannot parse HTTP message (../src/nrf/nrf-sm.c:70)
{

	"title":	"cannot parse HTTP message",
	"status":	400
}08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] DEBUG: STATUS [400] (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:357)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] DEBUG: SENDING...: 57 (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:365)
08/26 14:34:57.178: [sbi] DEBUG: {
	"title":	"cannot parse HTTP message",
	"status":	400
} (../lib/sbi/nghttp2-server.c:366)
```
I have already checked attach log file. As I understood, before patch msg my mock NF should be in REGISTERED state. Therefore, it is necessary to successfully process SBI module. 

I tried to compare the execution process of hearbeat and registration with my library and open5gs NFs, but I can't see any significant changes that may lead to the presented errors.

[nrf.log](https://github.com/open5gs/open5gs/files/9432864/nrf.log)
